description: Paktai Geo brings together geospatial analysis, machine learning and socioeconomic research in Quito. For Dancing with the SARs, we plan to explore NISAR surface-change observations and communicate them through an accessible interactive map. We welcome radar remote sensing, GIS, data validation and web skills. Spanish and English are welcome. Existing flood research is background experience; challenge-specific work will begin during the hackathon.
